key_points: WDC’s 20% monthly decline is driven largely by sector-wide AI/memory de-rating rather than a company-specific fundamental break.
Headlines still point to strong AI-driven HDD demand, rising margins, and upbeat guidance, supporting the longer-term thesis.
NAND glut warnings primarily hit SanDisk/Micron and have limited direct read-through to WDC’s HDD business, though sentiment spillover is real.
An officer’s $6.17M stock sale and hedge-fund tech selling add near-term caution but are not thesis-changing.
Nvidia’s reassuring AI earnings help offset broader AI-infrastructure jitters; net effect is modestly negative momentum with a neutral fundamental view.
